prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 15-second 9:16 vertical livestream performance in a high-end cyberpunk neon studio at 4K. An adult Northeast Chinese MC performer wears a pink fluffy coat over a camisole, oversized diamond headphones, and holds a professional condenser microphone. Two black-clad bodyguards in sunglasses stand behind her. From 0-5 seconds, lights focus on her face as she smiles, sharpens her expression into MC mode, presses one hand to her headphones, and sways to the "boom-boom-clap" beat while bodyguards nod in sync. From 5-10 seconds, a livestream screen displays neon "Night Paris" text and an Eiffel Tower laser; she holds the microphone with both hands and performs confidently while the bodyguards make synchronized hand-flower gestures. Golden streamers and champagne-colored light spots float through flashing lights. From 10-15 seconds, pull back to the luxurious studio as she makes a playful finger-point gesture toward camera, the bodyguards put on sunglasses and cross arms, and virtual gift effects of sports cars and yachts surround the trio. Freeze on the coolest pose. Use Night Paris DJ slow remix direction; no extra logos or text beyond the source display.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, watermark, unintended text, logo distortion, weapon, threatening gesture, graphic violence, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
